searchText: medalla.beaconcha.in has a tracker Question specific to testnet launch - If user does not have required infra to run validator now then is it possible to opt for any test net service like rocketpool for this test net? > Question specific to testnet launch - If user does not have required infra to run validator now then is it possible to opt for any test net service like rocketpool for this test net? <@654738470106955786> Rocket Pool will launch on Medalla a few days/weeks? after the launch of Medalla. It's likely that other staking services providers will launch on Medalla as well Is there a reason why in the deposit contract `DepositEvent` event, either `pubkey` or `index` are not an indexed parameters? It would make it so much cheaper to check if a given validator has already deposited. <@!688748669268132001> ``` curl --data '{"query": "{deposits(where {validatorPubKey:\"0xa2fbaa9e4b454c672ff1e89cd70c5f5e84d7dfab9a3b011c12d56d6f3e56aef0a760ba3e7df78ed8f2783971ea54962a\"}){index amount withdrawalCredentials signature}}"}' https://api.thegraph.com/subgraphs/name/attestantio/eth2deposits-medalla ``` <@!144468805697929216> That would work! But assuming one does not want to use TheGraph and only their own node, the previous question still applies? Okay well the specific answer is likely to be "no particular reason but too late to change it now" (which is why I built that subgraph)
